Refit a model from one of its random starts

refit_start.Rd

Reruns the fit of model from its random start number id only, the analogue of Mplus OPTSEED: the same data and options, stage 1 (stage1_iter EM iterations from that start's own random-number stream) and stage 2 (EM to convergence), exactly as the start ran within the multistart. Useful to inspect a local maximum.

Usage

refit_start(model, id)

Arguments

model

A fitted latentmix model.

id

A start number.

Value

A latentmix model fitted from that start only.

Details

The default random starts are starts = c(100, 20) with 20 stage-1 iterations (Mplus STARTS = 100 20; STITERATIONS = 20): 100 random starts are iterated 20 times each and the 20 best are run to convergence. The start numbers and their log-likelihoods are listed by convergence(). The same is available when fitting with optseed = id. refit_start() re-evaluates the call of model with optseed = id in the calling environment, so the data must still be available under the same name. The listed log-likelihoods are those of EM; with polish = TRUE (the default) the refitted model is Newton-polished like model itself, so its logLik() is equal or slightly higher.

See also

lca() (arguments start and optseed), convergence().
